properties.name: chroma.initial-topics
properties.description: Comma-separated list of topics pre-loaded into the RAG system.

properties.name: chroma.distance-threshold
properties.description: Maximum distance for a ChromaDB result to be considered relevant.

properties.name: locate.chroma.collection
properties.description: ChromaDB collection ID used for page-level PDF locate index.

properties.name: locate.pdf.base-url
properties.description: Base URL prefix (file server address) the /locate endpoint prepends to a PDF's file name.

properties.name: locate.distance-threshold
properties.description: Maximum distance for a /locate result to be considered relevant.

properties.name: locate.max-results
properties.description: Number of nearest chunks to fetch from Chroma per /locate query.

properties.name: security.api-key.chroma
properties.description: Required X-API-Key value for endpoints that go through Chroma (/rag/*, /locate/*).

properties.name: security.api-key.admin
properties.description: Required X-API-Key value for all other endpoints.
